# inferred from

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:inferredFrom`](gmeow-inferredFrom.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inferredFrom>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a concluded [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) to a premise it was inferred from — the flat, reification-free shortcut (the 80% case). NOT functional: a conclusion may rest on several premises. When the full argument structure matters, reify with a [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) ([`gmeow:pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md)) whose [`gmeow:premise`](gmeow-premise.md) / [`gmeow:conclusion`](gmeow-conclusion.md) carry the same content.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:inferredFrom`](gmeow-inferredFrom.md) from [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Analogy

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/analogy.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/analogy.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-inference-examples-analogy)#example-slices-core-inference-examples-analogy

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



ex:conclElectronsOrbit a gmeow:StandpointClaim ;
    rdfs:label "By analogy: electrons orbit the nucleus"@en ;
    gmeow:vantage ex:physicist ;
    gmeow:observedFeature ex:propElectronsOrbitNucleus ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodExpertJudgement ;
    gmeow:claimModality gmeow:probable ;          # not truth-preserving → probable
    gmeow:inferenceMode gmeow:modeAnalogical ;
    gmeow:inferredFrom ex:premOrbits .
```

### Belief Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/belief-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/belief-revision.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-inference-examples-belief-revision)#example-slices-core-inference-examples-belief-revision

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# The conclusion — now SUPPRESSED, but retained.
ex:conclPrinterBroken a gmeow:StandpointClaim ;
    rdfs:label "Concluded (then retracted): the printer is broken"@en ;
    gmeow:vantage ex:operator ;
    gmeow:observedFeature ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodExpertJudgement ;
    gmeow:claimModality gmeow:probable ;
    gmeow:inferenceMode gmeow:modeInduction ;
    gmeow:inferredFrom ex:premDidNotPrint ;
    gmeow:displayable false .                     # Principle 10: suppressed by the fired defeater
```

## Usage Advice

### Scope notes

- Range is intentionally OPEN: a premise may be another [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md), a [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md), an observation, or any reified statement. Mirrors the open-range precedent of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md).
